name: slide-decks
title_zh: PPT 手术台：读大纲、套版式、渲染成图检查
tagline_zh: 改稿不用反复打开 PowerPoint——先读现有大纲，再按模板版式生成幻灯片，文字表格图表齐整落位。
tagline_en: Stop reopening PowerPoint to edit. Outline first, generate slides from template layouts, place text/tables/charts.
desc_en: Build, read, and revise PowerPoint decks (.pptx) — outline an existing deck, generate slides from a template's layouts with python-pptx, place text, tables, charts, and images on a consistent grid, and render to images or PDF for a visual check. Use when the request names slides, a deck, a presentation, or a .pptx; not for Word, spreadsheets, PDFs, or web pages.
why_zh: 它把「看稿」和「改稿」拆成两步：先读大纲让你知道动了什么，再渲染成图让你看见结果——不用盲改。
why_en: It separates reading from editing: outline first to know what changed, render after to see the result—no blind edits, no GUI.
limit_zh: 只认 .pptx，不碰 Word/表格/PDF/网页。依赖 python-pptx 和本机渲染器（LibreOffic…
limit_en: Only .pptx—no Word, sheets, PDF, or web. Needs python-pptx and a local renderer (LibreOffice/PowerPoint); complex master layouts may misalign.
title_en: PPT Operating Table: Outline, Layouts, Render to Check
